hypothesis: The 650-character region target is currently a hard mid-proposition split whenever an accumulated PDF-text line group crosses the threshold without terminal punctuation. Making 650 a soft target and extending only to the next terminal line, under a strict 1200-character hard ceiling, will improve proposition completeness without changing retrieval ranking semantics or claim/guard behavior.
